takeaway.text: Mitchell Hashimoto's "AI psychosis" observation tops HN at 1,122 pts (511 comments, 0.46:1 ratio) — the day's signal is the practitioner class naming what they've been watching for months: companies making irrational decisions driven by AI hype rather than first principles, abandoning working systems and competent people for speculative AI replacements that don't exist yet. The same day, a 0-click Pixel 10 exploit chain (357 pts), a California bill mandating game patch-or-refund (418 pts), and Bun's Rust rewrite merging (94 Lobsters pts) complete a picture: AI psychosis is the meta-concern while the specific engineering work — security, software rights, runtime infrastructure — continues at pace.
